name: principle-model-the-domain
purpose: Encode domain rules in concrete structures that remove invalid states, repeated assumptions and scattered branches.
triggers: Branches or repeated shape assumptions spread across files
inputs: Domain invariants, transitions and access patterns
outputs: Concrete domain structure and valid state transitions with explained invariants; implementation and observed checks when authorized and available
ordinaryExample: Replace queued, running and completed job booleans with states carrying worker IDs or results and explicit allowed transitions.
capabilityLimits: Missing source or domain rules keep the design provisional.
Unavailable writes or execution allow a reduced proposal with unperformed checks stated.
Preserve disable-model-invocation metadata without assuming host enforcement.
Host behavior has not been tested.
